blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Senate on Monday commended Pinoy pop boy group SB19 for its performance at the Lollapalooza Music Festival in Chicago. Senate Resolution No. 545 was unanimously approved, congratulating and commending SB19 for being the first Filipino act to perform at the Lollapalooza Music Festival. It also recognized the group’s outstanding achievements and contributions to the country’s creative industry. The five-member boy group took the stage on the first day of Lollapalooza on July 30 at Grant Park in Chicago, performing songs including “DAM,” “Gento,” and “MAPA.” They also performed their latest song, “Lawless,” live for the first time.
